model: One common momentum-independent left current with orthogonal light partners, equal mu and tau coupling magnitudes, ordinary meson and tau kinematics/radiative functions. Normalize amplitudes by |g_mu|. Each reciprocal return uses the same vertex and its adjoint with scalar passage.
window: Simultaneous rectangular working ranges, each experiment and each retained theory error varied by the declared multiple of its own width. No joint confidence level, global fit, or claim of a blind data selection.
countermodel: Light unobserved Dirac partners with equal row norms and variable electron/muon row angle, tau orthogonal. Kinematic ratios alone do not fix partner overlaps. Not a separate renormalizable minimal SM.
